kinds.a: CPAP · APAP · auto-CPAP · sleep apnoea machine · PAP machine
kinds.d: Bedside pump that blows pressurised air through a hose and mask to keep the airway open during sleep.
t: Mask & tubing (spare parts): nasal pillows, nasal, full-face, hybrid

kinds.a: oxygen machine · POC · portable oxygen concentrator · home oxygen concentrator
kinds.d: Machine that filters nitrogen from room air to deliver oxygen-rich air through a cannula or mask.
Device that turns liquid medicine into a mist to be breathed in.

kinds.a: spacer · valved holding chamber · VHC · aerochamber
kinds.d: Chamber fitted between a metered-dose inhaler and the mouth so the dose can be breathed in slowly.

kinds.a: personal steam inhaler · steam vaporiser · facial steamer
kinds.d: Device that makes warm steam to be breathed in for cold, cough or sinus relief, without liquid medicine.

kinds.a: snoring mouthpiece · mandibular advancement device · MAD · anti-snore mouth guard
kinds.d: Night-time aid, usually a mouthpiece that holds the lower jaw forward, to reduce snoring.
